title: HOW RED FOXES HUNT, SCAVENGE, AND LEARN
caption: Red foxes hunt, sometimes investigate human leftovers, and practice through play. Separate archival clips; not one continuous event. #RedFox #FoxKits #Wildlife #WildVox Footage creators: Lubo Ondrasko; Scarabinol; J Tee; Peter.shaman; U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service National Conservation Training Center; Alexis Markwick; Pink Bee; Rhododendrites. Original licenses: CC BY 3.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, Public domain, CC0. Edits: excerpts, narration, subtitles, portrait framing. Adapted footage CC BY-SA 4.0 where required; source/credit/license details: github.com/lulualcides-sys/wildvox-automation/blob/main/qa/credits/2026-10-29.md

narration_timeline.text: A red fox can turn an ordinary patch of grass into a hunting ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual red fox searching grassy ground; no fabricated pounce.

narration_timeline.text: It slows down, listens for movement, and watches for the right moment to approach.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate real red fox scanning meadow for prey; subject may be distant.

narration_timeline.text: Sometimes a mouse is the prize, but a fox does not depend on one kind of meal.
narration_timeline.scene: Real red fox hunting on snow; mouse catch not asserted as visibly captured in every shot.

narration_timeline.text: In towns, a hungry fox may even investigate discarded takeout. Yes, really.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic fox investigating discarded takeout packaging, no endorsement of feeding wildlife.

narration_timeline.text: Young foxes start learning by watching and exploring the world around them.
narration_timeline.scene: Archival USFWS fox cubs and separate genuine young foxes exploring along a roadside in Delaware in May 2026; not the same litter or a shown den.

narration_timeline.text: Then play turns into practice: every chase and tumble helps prepare a future hunter.
narration_timeline.scene: Two different authentic recordings of young red foxes playing in gardens.
